name: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines (AP4M)
summary: Mastercard's x402-based machine-to-machine payments for AI agents: signed payment vouchers within pre-authorized budgets; early-access pilot, not commercially available.
description: An agent answers an HTTP 402 Payment Required challenge with a cryptographically signed payment voucher ("a secure promise to pay") within spending limits and policies set by its principal; providers verify, deliver, and can batch vouchers to redeem later, off-chain. Announced at Cloudflare Connect on 2026-10-20 after pilots with Cloudflare, Ant International, AIsa, Base, BVNK, Coinbase and Hype; the early-access program gives developers APIs, tools and documentation. **Mastercard states it is still a pilot and not available commercially**; sign-up is for the pilot.

agent_access.notes: Early access by sign-up only; no public API docs at the time of verification.
